title: Product Feature List
description: A product's features and specifications for its product page, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading and a sentence of introduction, an icon, a title and a sentence per feature, then a list of specifications (label and value) and one call to action, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — two feature columns and each specification's label beside its value at @sm, a larger heading at @md, and four feature columns, two columns of specifications and more room above and below at @lg.
